title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users
content: Learn how OpenAI evolved Habitat from a Python library into a globally distributed storage platform serving 1 billion ChatGPT users and 22M requests per second.

title: Cognition helps Devin test its own work with GPT‑6 Astra
content: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.
